payload.text: I read this as Implementation - inspect the session persistence, storage keys, and branch filter implementations, capture RED test failures, implement targeted fixes for F7, F8, F10, and F11, and verify GREEN with typechecks.

### Summary of Completed Deliverables #### 1. F7 & F8: Restored Session Worktree Identity Matching and Legacy Pane Leaf ID Mapping - **F7 Fix (`ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts`)**: In `deserializeWorkspaceState`, restored terminal sessions now correlate `sess.worktreePath || sess.cwd` with the restored worktree list and resolve `worktree: matchingWorktree ? worktreeIdentity(matchingWorktree) : null`, allowing Header and Sidebar agent/worktree identity matching to work correctly. - **F8 Fix (`ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts`)**: When legacy serialized tabs lack `sessionIdsByLeafId`, `deserializeWorkspaceState` uses `collectLeafIds(t.paneTree)` to build a map of `[leafId]: defaultSessionId` keyed by `leafId` rather than `t.id`. #### 2. F10: Unified Storage Keys Under `ferryx.*` with Migration Helper - **Shared Module (`ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts`)**: Created a single source of truth exporting `PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY`, `ACTIVE_PROJECT_STORAGE_KEY`, `SIDEBAR_OPEN_STORAGE_KEY`, `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_STORAGE_KEY`, `SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED_PROJECTS_STORAGE_KEY`, `TERMINAL_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY`, `NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY`, and `getMigratedItem(key, storage)`. - **Migration Logic**: `getMigratedItem` checks the `ferryx.*` key first; if absent, reads from the corresponding legacy key (`rorca.*`, `orca.*`), saves it to the new `ferryx.*` key, and returns the value. - **Call Sites Updated**: - `ui/src/App.tsx` - `ui/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` - `ui/src/lib/notificationSettings.ts` - `ui/src/lib/terminalSettings.ts` - `ui/src/App.test.tsx` (real constants and migration assertions aligned) #### 3. F11: Shared Branch Filter Helper - **Shared Module (`ui/src/lib/branchFilter.ts`)**: Extracted `branchName` and `displayWorkspaceTitle` / `workspaceName`, standardizing exclusions (`"detached HEAD"`, `"ferryx"`, `"rorca"`, `"orca-lite"`). - **Import Alignment**: Imported and used directly by both `ui/src/components/WorktreeList.tsx` and `ui/src/components/WorkspaceHeader.tsx`. --- ### Failing-First (RED) Evidence Excerpts #### F7 (Restored Session Worktree Identity) ``` FAIL src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts > sessionPersistence serialization and tab-group support > restores worktree identity on sessions matching worktree path (F7) AssertionError: expected null to deeply equal { wsId: 'default', slug: 'feature-branch' } - Expected: { "slug": "feature-branch", "wsId": "default", } + Received: null ❯ src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts:175:57 ``` #### F10 (Storage Keys Constants & Migration) ``` FAIL src/lib/storageKeys.test.ts [ src/lib/storageKeys.test.ts ] Error: Failed to resolve import "./storageKeys" from "src/lib/storageKeys.test.ts".
